We are excited to announce that registration is now open for the International Conference on Handheld Laser Beam Welding (HLBW), taking place:

📅 June 25–26, 2026  
📍 Edmonton, Alberta, Canada
📝 [Register Here](https://www.ccwjannualseminar.ca/registration)

This landmark event brings together world-leading experts to explore the latest advancements, industrial applications, and future directions of handheld laser beam welding technology.

📣 Program Highlights, Pricing, Sponsorship Opportunities, and Open Call Abstracts
Full conference information can be found at:  
🔗 [CCWJ Annual Seminar 2025](https://www.ccwjannualseminar.ca/)

## What to Expect

✨ Early Bird Pricing Now Available  
Secure your spot early and take advantage of discounted rates.

🔬 Cutting-edge Technical Sessions  
Learn from global experts sharing real-world applications, safety practices, process optimization, and innovations in HLBW.

🤝 Networking & Collaboration  
Connect with researchers, industry partners, manufacturers, and technology developers from around the world.

We look forward to welcoming you to Edmonton in 2026 for two days of collaboration, innovation, and technical exchange in handheld laser beam welding.
